faq.q: How many hours a day do French Bulldogs sleep?
faq.a: There is no validated French Bulldog-specific daily range. Studies of other dogs provide approximate averages, but a change in your dog's usual sleep or alertness matters more than a fixed number.

faq.q: How much do French Bulldog puppies sleep?
faq.a: In a large UK study, 16-week-old puppies slept about 11 hours a day: around 7 hours at night plus 3.5 hours of naps. We found no reliable source for the often-repeated 18 to 20 hours.

faq.q: Why does my French Bulldog sleep all day?
faq.a: Sleep patterns vary. New daytime sleepiness, disrupted sleep or heavy breathing can indicate medical problems, so seek a veterinary evaluation rather than assuming the dog is simply lazy.

faq.q: Is it normal for French Bulldogs to snore?
faq.a: It is common but not normal. Cambridge researchers say snoring and snorting signal an obstructed airway. Film your dog sleeping and show your vet.

faq.q: Why does my French Bulldog sleep with his eyes open?
faq.a: Incomplete eyelid closure can expose the cornea. Seek veterinary care for persistent exposure, redness, cloudiness, discharge or squinting; appearance alone cannot prove the eye is healthy.
